scope: Independent read-only CPU/control-plane review. Canonical official completion and the future 296x3 first-attempt GPU cohort have not been executed by this review.
resolved_findings: Actual GPU UUID visibility and cuda:0 device count checked before first worker, in addition to Docker DeviceRequests.
All deterministic frozen expert actor keys and native observation-normalizer buffers compared bitwise to final ordered teacher checkpoints.
Observed manifests and final marker log bound to the original training container mounts; old and new source manifest files hashed.
Existing coverage containers require exact four mount destinations/read-only flags, accepted image/entrypoint, fixed cwd/command/role/network and UUID.
Canonical rollout size, obstacle variants/seed42, save500, steps24, minibatches4/96 and epochs5/2 checked in recovered native PT configs.
One monitor lock across coverage output directories plus per-output lock and the original official lock held throughout each child job.
Selection identity includes the absolute host coverage output path, so a fresh cohort receives different CPU/GPU container names and cannot collide with an old mounted cohort.
confirmed_behavior: Unfinished canonical stage manifests return waiting before any Docker/GPU query or child launch; dry-run does not write or start containers.

Existing passed or failed first attempts are retained; an interrupted/ambiguous first attempt becomes execution_failed and is never automatically rerun. --resume-interrupted only continues unattempted cases.
verify_finished_batch recursively translates paths into new in-memory dictionaries/lists; actual original case/quality file bytes and hashes are untouched.

Watch may wait while its own child holds the official lock. The child does not need the monitor lock and releases the official lock on exit; the next observation can proceed. There is no cyclic lock dependency.
Final 888 summary must match all immutable per-case receipts and plans, include all source IDs without duplicates, pass retained-artifact SHA checks, and agree with the stopped container exit status.
limits: No host/server packages installed; no GPU/SSH/cloud operation or frozen training source modification.
Tests use explicit control-plane fixtures; real device guard execution and complete official 888 coverage remain future work after actual official training completion.

The native driver does not persist a shell exit receipt; its completion observation deliberately records driver_exit_status=null and relies on all 16 passed manifests, terminal marker, absent active children and released official lock.
